baseline.evidence_level: GitHub PR metadata and original Git; title not runtime proof

decision.selected: README first-screen two-mode table + offline verified ZIP navigator via existing verify-process + seeded 12-dimensional semantic replay
reject: new web server adds unneeded auth/runtime risk

invariants.model_limit: 1M finite cases, not independently executed Git changes, human trials or universal correctness

nodes.title: R0_HISTORY — SOURCE obligation
nodes.claim: 89 GitHub PRs; 86 merged; three unmerged; base Git SHA

nodes.title: R1_BEGINNER — SOURCE obligation
nodes.claim: product definition first; two modes in table; beginner default METHOD_ONLY; five accurate steps; no runner implication

nodes.title: R2_COCKPIT — SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME obligation
nodes.claim: verify ZIP against integrated receipt; all anchor links resolve; HTML injection escaped; no JS or outbound network; real One-Run CLI execution

nodes.title: R3_SCENARIOS — FINITE_MODEL obligation
nodes.claim: 12 interacting dimensions; 1000000 distinct semantic tuples; seed 883 replay twice; independent outcome oracle; zero mismatches and authority promotions
nodes.witness: finite scenario generator + CI retained artifacts

nodes.title: R4_HEAD_CI — SOURCE_CI obligation
nodes.claim: 14 active workflows pass on final HEAD; no acceptance bypass
requires: 14 active workflows pass on final HEAD

nodes.title: R5_HUMAN — EXTERNAL obligation
nodes.claim: independent beginner and CTO task studies with browser and ChatGPT; user confusion and failure observations
requires: independent beginner and CTO task studies with browser and ChatGPT

nodes.title: R6_TARGET — EXTERNAL obligation
nodes.claim: maintained target native API/browser/security evidence; rollback rehearsal

nodes.title: R7_HOST — EXTERNAL obligation
nodes.claim: verified branch rules; non-author review; provenance and signed artifact; publication authorization
All R0-R4 must pass on one authentic final HEAD; source-only acceptance without promotion of external evidence
External beginner usability, maintained-target execution and independently authenticated host/reviewer decision are required

self_audit_closure.evidence_policy: Each leaf needs named exact-SHA witness; model PASS cannot override Git, browser, independent host or reviewer FAIL; host-control nodes are EXTERNAL and cannot be satisfied by local model observations; the original G_PUBLIC_RELEASE root is explicitly reached and retains its independent external gates

nodes.acceptance: Typed CORA_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE with safe ZIP source-only path; original history never inferred from fabricated commits

witnesses: GitHub check-runs of final PR HEAD
nodes.acceptance: All applicable candidate CI required source jobs green on the very same final SHA; missing or failing cannot be compensated

falsifiers: external PASS injected into source report
nodes.acceptance: No self-approval, autonomous writes, merge, publication, time estimate or release promotion
ZIP-safe source inspection and original-Git-only genealogy are explicitly distinguished
Verified ZIP navigable with all three nonexecuting human-mediated choices; browser test separate from link-model test

falsifiers: host data copied from stale SHA
missing authentication presented as protected host
nodes.acceptance: Native metadata bound to exact final SHA, explicit BLOCKED_EXTERNAL if branch/reviewer enforcement unavailable

witnesses: CI diagnostics retained at failing step
falsifiers: raw not-a-tree-object error shown as source PASS
nodes.acceptance: Structured classification and inspectable failure, never silent fallback or blanket green

falsifiers: method mode misdescribed as engine execution
nodes.acceptance: Two modes and for-beginner entry with accurate runner/ZIP boundaries

falsifiers: scope-only PASS turned into external approval
nodes.acceptance: All P1 source/CI leaves verified, external observations explicitly distinguished
P0 source readiness at final HEAD, no skipped failure
Source review candidate only; cannot grant release
Independent human, target and host gates; not satisfiable by PR alone

deferred_p2.obligation: Triaging candidates by measured implementation and responsibility reduction; characterize runtime, prove preserved external behavior, avoid delete-by-import
Separately measure physical, implementational and architectural contraction after equivalence and owner review
